description: Honest pregame MLB model (sports/mlb/pregame_model.py). Win: logistic regression on Elo + decayed starter FIP/K-BB%/IP + park/weather. Runs: Poisson GLM + negative-binomial dispersion. Refit monthly on all games before the month; evaluated walk-forward.

evaluation.method: monthly walk-forward from 2024-01-01; refit at each month start on every completed game before it (2020 onward, all game types); regular_season scope is comparable with the plan's figures

season_walk_forward.method: refit once per season on every completed game of earlier seasons (plan P1-11 protocol)

market_baselines.source: bf_mlb_2025.csv: ESPN BET closing lines (ESPN public odds API), de-vigged proportionally; regular season, matched by teams + start time + final score

totals.line: posted closing total (p0_total) with its over/under prices

runLine.method: market-anchored = logistic on logit(de-vigged moneyline), posted total and their product, fit on games before 2025-07-01 (n=1231), scored on games from 2025-07-01 (n=1148); NB = the walk-forward runs model on the same games
